Title: DLH Request Forms
Description:
Tracker and Form for the following DLH Process: 
Deltek Learning Hub Platform Issues
Deltek Learning Hub Feedback and Enhancement Requests
DLH Content Change & Upload Request

Title: Town Hall Questions Agent
Description: For use around Customer Product Town Halls, particularly in analyzing questions submitted by customers, developing action plans from customer feedback, and responding to customer questions.

Title: Release Content Assistant
Description: Release Content Assistant is an AI assistant used with Copilot to help keep release information aligned across formats. It supports Release Highlights, What’s New videos, and What’s New IAGs by adapting the same source to different levels of detail, while following Deltek voice and tone. It’s assistive only and does not invent content.

Title: TFS Release Notes Generator
Description: The TFS Release Notes Generator is a web-based tool for creating release notes. It pulls work items directly from TFS, lets you review and filter them based on your team’s needs, and exports the results in Markdown or PDF format. The content comes from the Documentation tab of each work item, which is populated using the Generate Edited Description TFS plugin.

Title: Markdown Content Storage (GitHub)
Description:
GitHub as source repository for Markdown content starting with the source files from the OH to Markdown conversion effort.

Note: Pending access and training for the entire CE team.

Title: CertQBot (CLX Exam Builder Agent)
Description: A specialized tool for generating certification exam questions for CLX, aligned with content from the Online Help guides to ensure accuracy and relevance.

Title: Document Update Recommender
Description:
Recommends updates to OLH/Admin Guide sections to reflect updated process behavior based on transcript excerpts. Outputs only the updated section, followed by a reasoning table explaining each change at a granular level. Handles special cases for unrelated, incomplete, or conflicting transcript information.

Formerly known as OLH/Admin Guide Update Recommender (aka Mega Prompt)

Title: ADO/TFS Work Item Templates
Description:
Streamlining work item creation with ADO/TFS templates

Usage
Standardizes and speeds up the creation of recurring work items by:
Saving time through the elimination of repetitive copy-paste steps
Ensuring consistency across work items
Reducing errors and omissions
Making data entry easier to use, automatically populating required fields with just one click
Promoting best practices
Allowing the use of document templates in team onboarding materials

Title: Replicon Terminology Accuracy Agent
Description: The goal of the agent is to ensure all Replicon-related content consistently uses the correct terminology, maintaining accuracy, clarity, and brand alignment across training, documentation, and communications.

Title: Link Inspector
Description: A toolkit for automating the testing of hyperlinks in learning assets (such as eLearning).

Title: Style Guide Agent for Online Help
Description: This agent acts as an editor of online help topics that reviews and revises content based on the CLX and PCD style guides. It also follows the formatting rules listed in the style guides and generates output that can be converted to your desired format.

Description:
A toolkit that works with ROCH360 (Markdown Builder) and is aimed to automate multiple steps involved in converting learning videos to Markdown such as stitching videos and captions as well as creating transcripts and table of contents.

Title: Transcript Cleaner
Description:
This agent helps correct spelling discrepancies and adds necessary punctuation to transcribed text from a voice recording for Deltek software. It includes UI screen names, URLs, and unclear parts examples with instructions for URL handling, voice recording context, and iterating on unclear parts for clarity and usability.

(aka Transcript Cleaner Agent)

Title: Word-to-Markdown Converter
Description:
A toolkit for converting Word documents to Markdown so they can be easily ingested and consumable via the Deltek Learning Hub.

For information about the step-by-step workflow on how to use the toolkit, see https://delteko365.sharepoint.com/sites/CustomerLearningExperience/SitePages/How-to-Convert-Word-Documents-to-Markdown-Bundles-for-Zoomin-Upload.aspx

Title: Release Notes Python Script
Description: This tool aims to automate the generation of release notes and works hand-in-hand with the Release Notes GenAI tool.
Changelog: December 2025 - Updated to generate another type of output, Markdown, in support of our Shift to Markdown initiative.

Title: Costpoint Summary Excel Listing Generator
Description:
This tool aims to streamline the creation of a Maintenance Release Summary Excel reports from TFS query data. 

To generate Excel reports:
1. Download the generator .exe file.
2. Export a Costpoint maintenance release query from TFS in CSV format and save it locally.
3. Run the executable:
    a. Double-click the executable to open it.
    b. When prompted, enter the version number and click Generate Excel.
    c. Select the CSV file containing the MR query data.

Title: User Story and Acceptance Criteria GenAI Tool
Description:
This tool is designed to streamline the creation of clear, concise, and consistent Agile documentation across product engineering teams.

By leveraging the Azure OpenAI Service integrated within Deltek’s Azure DevOps (ADO) platform, this plug-in tool enables any team member with access to ADO projects to generate or enhance user stories and acceptance criteria directly within their work items.

This tool aligns with Agile@Deltek principles by helping reduce manual effort and promoting clarity, consistency, and efficiency across the software development lifecycle. It is designed to benefit not only writers, but also product managers, developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders involved in product delivery.

To access the tool:
1. From Deltek's ADO/TFS instance, open a project's work item (such as Feature or PBI).
2. Click More actions (...).
3. Select Generate Acceptance Criteria.

Title: Release Notes GenAI Tool
Description:
This tool aims to reduce the editorial hours spent on RN descriptions by 100%.

By using the Azure OpenAI Service available within Deltek’s Azure DevOps (ADO) platform, this plug-in tool enables anyone from each product engineering group who has access to ADO projects to use generative AI technology to edit RN descriptions directly from their projects' work items.

To access the tool:
1. From Deltek's ADO/TFS instance, open a project's work item (such as Feature, PBI, or Bug).
2. Click More actions (...).
3. Select Generate Edited Description.

Title: CLX Innovation Center SharePoint Site
Description:
The official one-stop-shop for information about all innovation efforts happening within the Customer Learning Experience (CLX) group.

One of the solutions that came out of our CLX Innovation Hackathon event, the CLX Innovation Center SharePoint site aims to "provide full transparency on everything we're doing with AI and automation."

Title: RoboHelp-to-Markdown Converter
Description:
A toolkit for converting RoboHelp topics to Markdown, generating a TOC, applying product taxonomy, and delivering a bundle for the Deltek Learning Hub.

For information about the step-by-step workflow on how to use the toolkit, see https://delteko365.sharepoint.com/sites/CustomerLearningExperience/SitePages/How-to-Convert-RoboHelp-Projects-to-Markdown-Bundles-for-Zoomin-Upload.aspx.

Title: ROCH360 (Markdown Builder)
Description:
This custom-built tool, generated with the aid of Claude Code, streamlines the development of Markdown content and packaging this content for DLH consumption; therefore, accelerating CLX content development processes.
